items.quote: So Moses brought Israel from the Red sea, and they went out into the wilderness of Shur
items.claim: The text says Moses led Israel away from the Red Sea into the wilderness of Shur.
items.action: led away from the Red Sea into the wilderness

items.quote: and they went three days in the wilderness, and found no water.
items.claim: The text says Israel travelled three days in the wilderness of Shur without finding water.
items.action: travelled three days without finding water
items.mechanism: lack of water on a desert march
